panels.description: Security shutters descend through the Halyard maker district, cutting across bright fabrication corridors. Keep the moving shutters dominant and leave upper space for sound.
Alex, Ada and Lina are separated from Suri, Jalen and Ren by a closing barrier. Keep no more than three named figures on Alex's side and leave upper space.
Alex jams his damaged wrist guard into the shutter track to hold it open. Keep the guard and mechanism clear; leave upper space.
Ada catches an access tool and throws it across the gap toward Alex. Make the handoff unmistakable and leave open air around the tool.
